messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend).  
For each entry I’ve included the holiday name, the actual date(s) that make up the long weekend, and a short note about any provincial variations that might affect your travel plans.

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|--------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18 – 20 2023** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Family Day is a provincial holiday; it falls on the third Monday in February in most provinces. |
| **Apr 7 – 9 2023** | Good Friday to Easter Monday | Good Friday (Apr 7) and Easter Monday (Apr 9) create a three‑day weekend. |
| **May 20 – 22 2023** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Jul 1 – 3 2023** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Aug 1 – 3 2023** | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Civic Holiday is a provincial holiday on the first Monday in August. |
| **Sep 2 – 4 2023** | Labour Day | Labour Day is a federal holiday on the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 – 9 2023** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday on the second Monday in October. |
| **Dec 23 – 25 2023** | Christmas | Christmas Day fell on Monday, creating a long weekend. |

### Quick Reference (by month)

| Month | Long‑Weekend Holiday | Observed Dates |
|-------|----------------------|----------------|
| January | New Year’s Day (observed) | Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023 |
| February | Family Day (provincial) | Feb 18 – 20 2023 |
| April | Good Friday – Easter Monday | Apr 7 – 9 2023 |
| May | Victoria Day | May 20 – 22 2023 |
| July | Canada Day (observed) | Jul 1 – 3 2023 |
| August | Civic Holiday (provincial) | Aug 1 – 3 2023 |
| September | Labour Day | Sep 2 – 4 2023 |
| October | Thanksgiving | Oct 7 – 9 2023 |
| December | Christmas | Dec 23 – 25 2023 |

> **Tip for your app:** If you’re targeting a specific province, remember that holidays such as Family Day, Civic Holiday, and others vary by province. You may want to allow users to select their province so the app can filter the appropriate long weekends.
